description: This file contains implementation of ASCII string utilities for the Abseil C++ library, including case conversion and whitespace removal functions.

methods.name: AsciiStrToLower
methods.description: Converts a string to lowercase ASCII.

methods.name: AsciiStrToUpper
methods.description: Converts a string to uppercase ASCII.

methods.name: RemoveExtraAsciiWhitespace
methods.description: Removes extra whitespace characters from a string, collapsing multiple whitespace into a single space.
